newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Health buys Specialty Healthcare.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Health buys Specialty Healthcare.

text.p: Horizon Health Corp said Monday that it has acquired privately-held Specialty Healthcare Management Inc of Englewood, Colorado for 1.4 million shares, or 20.1 percent of its outstanding stock.
The company said the transaction, approved by shareholders today, would be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

Specialty is a contract manager of mental health, physical rehabilitation and chemical dependency treatment programs, and had revenues of $23.2 million and profits of $871,000 in the nine months ended May 31.
Horizon, a contract manager of clinical programs offered by acute care hospitals, had revenues of $52.7 million and profits of $5.5. million in the same period.
The company also voted to change its name and trading symbol Monday from Horizon Mental Health Management Inc to Horizon Health Corp.
Its shares closed Monday at 24-3/4, up 1-1/2.
